units.source_text: 二人乘天色未明之时匆匆归京。

en.t: The two of them hurried back to the capital before daybreak.

units.source_text: 匂亲王似觉这归时路程比来时更远了。

en.t: Prince Niou felt as though the road home was even longer than it had been on the way there.

units.source_text: 预料今后往来不便，不免忧虑。

en.t: Thinking that travel back and forth would be difficult from now on, he could not help feeling anxious.

units.source_text: 想起古歌“岂能一夜不相逢”之句，心甚懊恼。

en.t: Remembering the old poem's line, how could one pass even a single night without meeting, he was deeply distressed.

units.source_text: 二人于清晨人影出入还少之时到达六条院，车子来到廊下，相与下车。

en.t: They reached the Rokujo estate early in the morning, while few people were yet coming and going, and when the carriage drew up beneath the gallery, they got out together.

units.source_text: 两位贵人从这辆侍女们用的竹舆中下来，甚觉异样，连忙躲进室内，相视而笑。

en.t: It felt very strange for two noble gentlemen to step down from a bamboo palanquin meant for ladies in waiting, so they quickly slipped indoors and laughed as they looked at each other.

units.source_text: 薰君对匂亲王说：“此次效劳非寻常可比，你应感谢我了。”

en.t: Kaoru said to Prince Niou, This service of mine was no ordinary favor, so you ought to be grateful to me.

units.source_text: 想起自己这引路人反而落空，心甚妒恨，但也并不向他诉苦。

en.t: When he thought that he, the very guide, had ended up empty handed instead, he felt deeply jealous and resentful, but he did not complain to the prince.

units.source_text: 匂亲王一回到家，马上写慰问信送到宇治去。

en.t: As soon as Prince Niou returned home, he immediately wrote a letter of consolation and sent it to Uji.
